$comment: Spec-036 Wave 4 — T-Z04 KQL templates materialised from contracts/sli-thresholds.md. Loaded by tests/devops/test_sli_kql_smoke.py and tests/e2e/test_staging_promotion_gates.py.

slis.name: P95 inject→fan-out latency
slis.kql: customEvents | where timestamp > ago(5m) | where name == "inject_telemetry.fan_out_complete" | extend latency_ms = todouble(customDimensions["fan_out_latency_ms"]) | extend tenant_id = tostring(customDimensions["tenant_id"]) | summarize p95_latency_ms = percentile(latency_ms, 95) by bin(timestamp, 1m), tenant_id | project timestamp, tenant_id, p95_latency_ms

slis.name: P99 audit gap-free invariant
slis.kql: let window = ago(7d); let counts = AuditEntries_CL | where TimeGenerated > window | summarize maxSeq = max(sequence_number), cnt = count() by simulation_id_g | extend gap = maxSeq - cnt; counts | summarize gappy = countif(gap != 0), total = count() | extend gap_free_pct = 100.0 * (1.0 - todouble(gappy) / total) | project gap_free_pct, gappy_count = gappy, total_simulations = total

slis.name: DLQ depth (sequence-uncertainty fail-closed)
slis.kql: customEvents | where timestamp > ago(1h) | where name == "audit.sequence.uncertainty" | summarize dlq_depth = count()

slis.name: Cosmos RU consumption headroom
slis.kql: AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.DOCUMENTDB" | where Category == "DataPlaneRequests" | summarize p95_ru = percentile(todouble(requestCharge_s), 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)

slis.name: Cascade degraded-to-annotation rate (T-Q03 affinity ladder)
slis.kql: customEvents | where timestamp > ago(1h) | where name in ("cascade.degraded_to_annotation", "cascade.fan_out_complete") | summarize degraded_pct = 100.0 * countif(name == "cascade.degraded_to_annotation") / count()

slis.name: P95 sub-agent reply latency (per model deployment)
slis.$comment: Cycle 2 / T-AA16 / A2-02 — staging-promotion gate per sli-thresholds.md row 6. Trailing 24 h window with 30-sample CLT floor (pass-2 Q4). Thresholds are model-specific: gpt-4o ≤ 4000 ms warn / ≤ 5000 ms breach; gpt-4o-mini ≤ 1500 ms warn / ≤ 2000 ms breach. Cycle 3 / T-AA34 / A3-05 — KQL aligned with contracts/sli-thresholds.md §6a canonical body (28-series cardinality restored via `extend sub_agent` + `summarize ... by sub_agent, model_deployment`; tnt-stg-smoke isolation filter added).
slis.kql: customEvents | where timestamp > ago(24h) | where name == "sub_agent.invocation.complete" | extend latency_ms = todouble(customDimensions["latency_ms"]) | extend sub_agent = tostring(customDimensions["sub_agent"]) | extend model_deployment = tostring(customDimensions["model_deployment"]) | extend env = tostring(customDimensions["env"]) | extend tenant_id = tostring(customDimensions["tenant_id"]) | where env == "staging" | where tenant_id == "tnt-stg-smoke" | summarize p95_latency_ms = percentile(latency_ms, 95), sample_count = count() by sub_agent, model_deployment | project sub_agent, model_deployment, p95_latency_ms, sample_count

slis.name: Map-overlay drift error budget (SSE delivery)
slis.$comment: Cycle 2 / T-AA16 / A2-02 — staging-promotion gate per sli-thresholds.md row 7. ≥ 99.5 % within 1500 ms over a trailing 24 h window with 30-sample CLT floor. Aligns with SC-013 staging-promotion gate (spec.md L2785-2797). Cycle 3 / T-AA34 / A3-06 — drift dimension corrected to `client_received_ms - server_emit_ms` per spec; breach_pct: 99.5 → 99.0 (distinct warn/breach bands); group `by model_deployment` (per A3-06 alignment with Z6 cardinality); tnt-stg-smoke isolation filter added.
slis.kql: customEvents | where timestamp > ago(24h) | where name == "sse.map_overlay.delivered" | extend client_received_ms = todouble(customDimensions["client_received_ms"]) | extend server_emit_ms = todouble(customDimensions["server_emit_ms"]) | extend drift_ms = client_received_ms - server_emit_ms | extend env = tostring(customDimensions["env"]) | extend tenant_id = tostring(customDimensions["tenant_id"]) | extend model_deployment = tostring(customDimensions["model_deployment"]) | where env == "staging" | where tenant_id == "tnt-stg-smoke" | summarize within_budget = countif(drift_ms <= 1500), sample_count = count() by model_deployment | extend drift_budget_pct = 100.0 * todouble(within_budget) / sample_count | project model_deployment, drift_budget_pct, sample_count
